svg.title: rag-cost-curve: benchmark of cost per correct answer for agentic RAG, iterative RAG, reranking and naive RAG
svg.desc: Meters every LLM call across naive, reranked, iterative and agentic RAG on multi-hop QA. Agentic RAG: +32.5 exact match at 2.5x the cost per correct answer. Reranking did not help.
